verdict.rationale: Radar's Dashboard shows a dispute/fraud-rate calculation on the Radar page, and Fraud Insights analytics chart transaction volume and fraud rates over time. That covers the dispute-rate part of the story directly. The review queue exists, but the evidence does not describe workload metrics, and nothing documents the other numbers or any export. Missing for 10: false-positive rate metric, approval-rate lift metric, review-workload reporting, export/board-ready reporting, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see the numbers that matter — dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift, review workload — and export them for the board

citations.quote: We show this calculation on the Radar page in the Dashboard.
Visualize trends in transaction volume and fraud rates over time. Identify combinations of Radar attributes that impact your fraud rates.
